Aqal-zada kafir aur Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam): Kafirun ko is par bara tajajjub hota tha ke ek insan Allah ka Rasool ban jaye. Kehte the ke kya bashar hamara hadi hoga? Hazrat Hud aur Hazrat Saleh ne apni kaum se farmaya tha ke kya tumhein yeh koi anokhi baat lagti hai ke tum mein se hi ek shakhs par tumhare Rabb ki wahi nazil hui. Kuffar-e-Quresh ne bhi kaha tha ke kya is ne itne sare mabudun ke bajaye ek hi Allah muqarrar kar diya? Yeh to bare hi tajajjub ki baat hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat se bhi unhon ne saaf inkar kar diya aur inkar ki wajah yahi pesh ki ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jaise ek insan par Allah ki wahi ka aana hi nahi maan sakte. Is ka zikr is ayat mein hai.

Sache paye se murad saadat aur neki ka zikr hai. Bhalaaiyon ka ajr hai. Un ke naik kaam hain. Misal ke tor par namaz, roza, sadqa, tasbeeh. Aur un ke liye Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki shafa'at. Al-gharz un ki sachai ka suboot Allah ko pahunch chuka hai. Un ke naik aamal wahan jama hain. Yeh sabiq log hain. Arab ke sheron mein bhi qadeem ka lafz in maano mein bola gaya hai. Jo Rasool un mein hai woh basheer bhi hai, nazeer bhi hai, lekin kafirun ne ise jadugar keh kar apne jhoot par mohar laga di.

Takhleeq-e-Kainat ki Qurani Roodad:
Tamam aalam ka Rab wahi hai. Aasman-o-Zameen ko sirf chhe din mein paida kar diya hai. Ya to aise hi mamooli din ya har din yahan ki ginti se aik hazaar din ke barabar ka. Phir Arsh par woh mustawi ho gaya. Jo sab se bari makhlooq hai aur sari makhlooq ki chhat hai. Jo surkh yaqoot ka hai. Jo noor se paida shuda hai. Yeh qaul ghareeb hai. Wahi tamam makhlooq ka intezam karta hai is se koi zarrah poshida nahi. Use koi kaam mashghool nahi kar leta. Woh sawalaat se ukta nahi sakta. Mangne walon ki pukaar use hairan nahi kar sakti. Har chhote bare ka, har khule chhupe ka, har zahir bahar ka, paharon mein samundaron mein, abadiyon mein, weeranon mein wahi bandobast kar raha hai. Har jandar ka rozi rsaan wahi hai. Har patte ke jharne ka use ilm hai, zameen ke andheron ke danon ki us ko khabar hai, har tar-o-khushk cheez khuli kitab mein maujood hai. Kehte hain ke is ayat ke nuzool ke waqt lashkar ka lashkar misl arabon ke jata dekha gaya. Un se poochha gaya ke tum kaun ho? Unhon ne kaha hum jinat hain. Hamein Madine se in ayaton ne nikala hai. Koi nahi jo is ki ijazat ke baghair sifarish kar sake. Aasman ke farishte bhi is ki ijazat ke baghair zaban nahi kholte. Isi ko shafaat nafa deti hai jis ke liye ijazat ho. Yehi Allah tum sab makhlooq ka palanhaar hai. Tum isi ki ibadat mein lage raho. Use wahid aur lashareek mano. Mushriko! Itni moti baat bhi tum nahi samajh sakte? Jo is ke sath doosron ko poojte ho halanki jaante ho ke khaliq malik wahi akela hai. Us ke woh khud qayil the. Zameen aasman aur Arsh-e-Azeem ka Rab isi ko mante the.

Qiyamat ka amal usi takhleeq ka iadah hai. Qiyamat ke din ek bhi na bachega sab apne Allah ke paas hazir kiye jayenge jaise is ne shuru mein paida kiya tha aise hi dobara iadah karega aur yeh is par bahut hi aasaan hoga. Us ke wade atal hain. Adl ke sath woh apne nek bandon ko ajr dega aur pura pura badla inayat farmayega. Kafiron ko bhi un ke kufr ka badla milega. Tarah tarah ki sazayein hongi, garam pani, garmi, garam lo un ke hisse mein aayengi aur bhi qism qism ke azab hote rahenge. Woh jahannam jise yeh jhutla rahe the un ka odhna bichona hogi. Us ke aur garam pighle hue tanbe jaise pani ke darmiyan yeh hairan o pareshan honge.

Allah Azza wa Jalla ki azmat-o-qudrat ke suboot mazahir-e-kayinat, us ki kamal-e-qudrat aur us ki azeem saltanat ki nishani yeh chamkeela aftab hai aur yeh roshan mahtab hai. Yeh aur hi fan hai aur woh aur hi kamal hai. Is mein bara hi farq hai. Is ki shu'ain jagmaga dein aur is ki shu'ain khud munawwar rahein. Din ko aftab ki saltanat rehti hai, raat ko mahtab ki jagmagahat rehti hai, un ki manzelein Us ne muqarrar kar rakhi hain. Chaand shuru mein chhota hota hai, chamak kam hoti hai, rafta rafta barhta hai aur roshan bhi hota hai phir apne kamal ko pohch kar ghatna shuru hota hai, wapsi agli halat par aa jata hai. Har mahine mein is ka yeh aik daur khatam hota hai, na sooraj chaand ko pakar le, na chaand sooraj ki raah roke, na din raat par sabaqat kare na raat din se aage barhe. Har aik apni apni jagah pabandi se chal phir raha rahta hai, daur khatam kar raha hai. Dono ki ginti sooraj ki chaal par aur mahino ki ginti chaand par hai. Yeh makhlooq abas nahi balki bahikmat hai. Zameen-o-Aasman aur un ke darmiyan ki cheezein batil paida shuda nahi. Yeh khyal to kafiron ka hai, jin ka thikana dozakh hai. Tum yeh na samajhna ke hum ne tumhein yoonhi paida kar diya hai aur ab tum hamare qabze se baahar ho. Yaad rakho, Main Allah hoon, Main Malik hoon, Main Haq hoon, Mere siwa kisi ki kuch chalti nahi. Arsh-e-Kareem bhi munjumla makhlooq ke meri adna makhlooq hai. Hujjatein aur daleelein hum khol khol kar bayan farma rahe hain ke ahl-e-ilm log samajh lein. Raat din ke radd-o-badal mein, un ke barabar jaane aane mein, raat par din ka aana, din par raat ka chha jana, aik dusre ke peechhe barabar lagataar aana jaana aur zameen-o-aasman ka paida hona aur un ki makhlooq ka rachaya jana yeh sab azmat-e-Rab ki bolti hui nishaniyan hain. Un se munh pher lena koi aqlmandi ki daleel nahi, yeh nishaanaat bhi jinhein faida na dein unhein iman kaise naseeb hoga? Tum apne aage peechhe upar neeche bohat si cheezein dekh sakte ho. Aqlmandon ke liye yeh bari bari nishaniyan hain, ke woh soch samajh kar Allah ke azabon se bach sakein aur Us ki rehmat hasil kar sakein.

Jo un ki khataon aur gunahon ka badla hai jo un ke kufr o shirk ki jaza hai.

Khush anjam khush naseeb log! Nek bakhtoun ka haal bayaan ho raha hai jo Allah par iman laaye, rasoolon ko maana, farmanbardari ki nekiyon par chalte rahe, unhein un ke iman ki wajah se raah mil jayegi. Pul-e-Sirat se paar ho jayenge. Jannat mein pahunch jayenge, noor mil jayega. Jis ki roshni mein chalenge phirenge. Pas mumkin hai ke (Aayat bi-imanihim) mein baa-sababiyat ki ho. Aur mumkin hai ke isti'anat ki ho. Un ke aamal achhi bhali soorat aur atr-o-khushbu ban kar un ke paas un ki qabr mein aayeinge aur unhein khushkhabri denge, yeh poochhenge ke tum kaun ho? Woh jawab denge tumhare nek aamal. Pas yeh apne un noorani amal ki roshni mein jannat mein pahunch jayenge aur kafiron ka amal nihayat bad-soorat, badbu-daar ho kar us par chimat jayega aur usay dhakke de kar jahannam mein le jayega. Yeh jo cheez khana chahenge usi waqt farishte usay tayyar kar ke laayeinge. Unhein salam kahenge, jo jawab denge aur khayenge. Kha kar apne Rab ki hamd bayaan karenge. Un ke sirf Subhanakallahumma kehte hi das hazaar khadim apne haathon mein sone ke katoron mein khana le kar hazir ho jayenge aur yeh sab mein se khayega. Un ka aapas mein bhi tuhfa salam hoga. Wahan koi laghvu baat kaanon mein na padegi. Dar-o-diwaar se salamati ki aawazein aati rahengi. Rab-e-Raheem ki taraf se bhi salamati ka qool hoga. Farishte bhi har ek darwaze se aa kar salam karenge. Aakhri qool un ka Allah ki sana hoga. Woh mabood-e-barhaq hai, awwal-o-akhir hamd-o-tareef ke saza-waar hain. Isi liye us ne apni hamd bayaan farmai makhluq ki paidaish ke shuru mein, us ki baqa mein, apni Kitab ke shuru mein, aur us ke nazil farmane ke shuru mein. Is qisam ki aayatein Quran-e-Kareem mein ek nahi kayi ek hain jaise (Alhamdu lillahil-lazi anzala 'ala 'abdihil-kitaba wa lam yaj'al lahu 'iwaja) (18. Al-Kahf: 1) waghera. Wahi awwal-o-akhir duniya-o-uqba mein laayiq-e-hamd-o-sana hai, har haal mein us ki hamd hai. Hadith-e-Shareef mein hai ke ahl-e-jannat se tasbeeh-o-hamd is tarah ada hogi jaise saans chalta rehta hai. Yeh is liye ke har waqt nematein, raahatein, aaram aur aasayish badhta hua dekhenge, pas la-mahalah hamd ada hogi. Sach hai, us ke siva koi mabood nahi, na us ke siva koi paalanhaar hai.

Allah Ta'ala apne ehsanat ka tazkira farmate hain, farman hai ke mere altaaf aur meri meharbaniyon ko dekho, ke bande kabhi kabhi tang akar, ghabra kar apne liye, apne baal bachon ke liye, apne malik ke liye bad-duayein kar بیٹھte hain lekin main unhein qabool karne mein jaldi nahi karta, warna woh kisi ghar ke na rahein jaisa ke main inhi cheezon ki barkat ki duayein qabool farma liya karta hoon warna yeh tabah ho jate hain. Pas bandon ko aisi bad-duayon se parhez karna chahiye. Chunache Musnad Bazzar ki hadith mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain: Apni jaan o maal par bad-duah na karo, aisa na ho ke kisi qubooliyat ki saat muwafiqat kar jaye aur woh bad-duah qabool ho jaye. Isi mazmoon ka bayan (وَيَدْعُ الْاِنْسَان بالشَّرِّ دُعَاۗءَهٗ بالْخَيْرِ ۭ وَكَانَ الْاِنْسَانُ عَجُوْلًا 11؀) (17. Al-Isra: 11) mein hai. Gharz yeh hai ke insan ka kisi waqt apni aulad, maal waghera ke liye bad-duah karna ke Allah use gharat kare waghera, agar naik duayon ki tarah qubooliyat mein hi aaja kare toh log barbad ho jayein.

Momin har haal mein Allah ka shukr baja late hain. Isi ayat jaisi (Wa iza massahush-sharru fa zu du'ain 'arid [41:51]) hai yani jab insan ko koi takleef pahunchti hai toh bari lambi lambi duayein karne lagta hai. Har waqt uthte baithte leite Allah se apni takleef ke door hone ki iltijayein karta hai. Lekin jahan dua qabul hui, takleef door hui aur aisa ho gaya jaise ke na use kabhi takleef pahunchi thi na usne kabhi dua ki thi. Aise log hadd se guzar jaane wale hain aur woh unhe apne aise hi gunah achche maloom hote hain. Haan imandar, naik a'mal, hidayat-o-rushd wale aise nahi hote. Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai Momin ki halat par taajjub hai. Uske liye har ilahi faisla achcha hi hota hai. Use takleef pahunchi usne sabr-o-istiqamat ikhtiyar ki aur use nekiyan milin. Use rahat pahunchi, usne shukr kiya, us par bhi nekiyan milin, yeh baat Momin ke siva kisi ko hasil nahi.

Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ki sabiqah aqwam par takzeeb-e-rasool ki wajah se azab aaye aur woh tahas nahas ho gaye. Ab tum unke qaim-maqam ho aur tumhare paas bhi Afzal-ur-Rusul aa chuke hain. Allah dekh raha hai ki tumhare aamal ki kya kaifiyat rehti hai? Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Duniya meethi, mazay ki, sabz rang wali hai. Allah Ta'ala ismein tumhein khalifa bana kar dekh raha hai ki tum kaise aamal karte ho? Duniya se hoshiyar raho aur aurton se hoshiyar raho. Bani Israel mein sabse pehla fitna aurton ka hi aaya tha. (Sahih Muslim)

Hazrat Auf bin Malik ne Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se kaha ki maine khwab mein dekha ki goya aasman se ek rassi latkayi gayi. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne to use mukammal tham liya, phir latkayi gayi to Abu Bakr Siddique (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne bhi usi tarah use mazbooti se tham liya. Phir mimbar ke gird o pesh logon ne naapna shuru kiya to Hazrat Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) teen zira' barh gaye. Hazrat Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne yeh khwab sun kar farmaya: Bas hatao bhi, hamein khwabon ki kya hajat? Phir apni khilafat ke zamanay mein Umar Farooq ne kaha: Auf, tumhara khwab kya tha? Hazrat Auf ne kaha: Jane dijiye jab aapko iski zaroorat hi nahi, aap ne jab mujhe daant diya phir ab kyun poochhte hain? Aap ne farmaya: Us waqt to tum Khaleefat-ur-Rasool ko unki maut ki khabar de rahe the, ab bayan karo. Unhon ne bayan kiya, to aap ne farmaya: Logon ka mimbar ki taraf teen zira' pana yeh tha ki ek to khalifa bar-haq tha, doosre khalifa ke bare mein kisi malamat karne wale ki malamat se bilkul be-parwah tha, teesra khalifa shaheed hai.

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Phir humne tumhein khalifa banaya ki hum tumhare aamal dekhein. He Umar ki maan ke larke! Tu khalifa bana hua hai, khoob dekh bhal le ke kya kya amal kar raha hai? Aap ka farmaan ki "Main Allah ke bare mein kisi malamat karne wale ki parwah nahi karta" se murad un cheezon mein hai jo Allah chahe. Shaheed hone se murad yeh hai ki jab Hazrat Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki shahadat hui, us waqt musalman aap ke mutee o farmanbardar the.

Hazrat Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne yeh khwab sun kar farmaya: Bas hatao bhi, hamein khwabon ki kya hajat? Phir apni khilafat ke zamanay mein Umar Farooq ne kaha: Auf, tumhara khwab kya tha? Hazrat Auf ne kaha: Jane dijiye jab aapko iski zaroorat hi nahi, aap ne jab mujhe daant diya phir ab kyun poochhte hain? Aap ne farmaya: Us waqt to tum Khaleefat-ur-Rasool ko unki maut ki khabar de rahe the, ab bayan karo. Unhon ne bayan kiya, to aap ne farmaya: Logon ka mimbar ki taraf teen zira' pana yeh tha ki ek to khalifa bar-haq tha, doosre khalifa ke bare mein kisi malamat karne wale ki malamat se bilkul be-parwah tha, teesra khalifa shaheed hai.

Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Phir humne tumhein khalifa banaya ki hum tumhare aamal dekhein. He Umar ki maan ke larke! Tu khalifa bana hua hai, khoob dekh bhal le ke kya kya amal kar raha hai? Aap ka farmaan ki "Main Allah ke bare mein kisi malamat karne wale ki parwah nahi karta" se murad un cheezon mein hai jo Allah chahe. Shaheed hone se murad yeh hai ki jab Hazrat Umar (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ki shahadat hui, us waqt musalman aap ke mutee o farmanbardar the.

Kuffar ki badtareen hujjatein: Makkah ke kuffar ka bughz dekhiye Quran sun kar kehne lage, ise to badal la, balki koi aur hi la. To jawab de ke yeh mere bas ki baat nahi main to Allah ka ghulam hoon iska rasool hoon iska kaha kehta hoon. Agar main aisa karoon to qayamat ke azab ka mujhe dar hai. Dekho is baat ki daleel yeh kya kam hai? Ke main ek be-parha likha shakhsh hoon tum log ustaad-e-kalam ho lekin phir bhi iska muariza aur muqabla nahi kar sakte. Meri sadaqat-o-amanat ke tum khud qayil ho. Meri dushmani ke bawajood tum aaj tak mujh par ungli tika nahi sakte. Isse pehle main tum mein apni umar ka bara hissa guzar chuka hoon. Kya phir bhi aql se kaam nahi lete? 

Shah-e-Room Herqal ne Abu Sufyan aur unke sathiyon se An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki sifaten daryaft karte hue poochha ke kya dawa-e-nabuwat se pehle kabhi tum ne ise jhoot ki tuhmat lagayi hai? To ise bawajood dushman aur kafir hone ke kehna para ke nahi, yeh hai aap ki sadaqat jo dushmanon ki zaban se bhi be-sakhta zahir hoti thi. Herqal ne nateeja bayan karte hue kaha tha ki main kaise maan loon ke logon ke mamlaat mein to jhoot na bole aur Allah par jhoot bohtan bandh le. 

Hazrat Jafar bin Abu Talib (R.A) ne darbar-e-Najashi mein Shah-e-Habash se farmaya tha hum mein Allah ne jis Rasul (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bheja hai hum uski sadaqat, amanat, nasab vagairah sab kuch jaante hain woh nabuwat se pehle hum mein chaalees saal guzar chuke hain. Saeed bin Musayyib (R.H) se tantalis saal marwi hain lekin mashhoor qaul pehla hi hai.

Mujrim aur zalimon ka sarghana, is se zyada zalim, is se zyada mujrim, is se zyada sarkash aur kaun hoga? Jo Allah par jhoot bandhe aur uski taraf nisbat kar ke woh kahe jo usne na farmaya ho. Risalat ka dawa kar de halanki Allah ne use na bheja ho. Aise jhoote log to aamiyon ke samne bhi chhup nahi sakte che jai ke aaqilon ke samne. Is gunah ka kabira tareen hona to kisi se makhfi nahi. Phir kaise ho sakta hai ki nabi is se ghafil rahein? Yaad rakho jo bhi mansab-e-nubuwwat ka dawa karta hai aur uski sadaqat ya jhoot par aise dalail qaim kar deti hai ki uska mamla bilkul hi khul jata hai. Ek taraf Hazrat Muhammad Rasulullah ﷺ ko lijiye aur dusri jaanib Musailama Kazaab ko rakhiye to itna hi farq maloom hoga jitna aadhi raat aur dopahar ke waqt mein. Donon ke akhlaq, aadaat, halat ka mu'aina karne wala, Huzoor ﷺ ki sachchai aur uski ghalat goi mein koi shak nahi kar sakta. Isi tarah Sajjah aur Aswad Ansi ka dawa hai ki nazar dalne ke baad kisi ko unke jhoot mein shak nahi rehta. Hazrat Abdullah bin Salam R.A farmate hain jab Rasulullah ﷺ Madine mein aaye log aap ke dekhne ke liye gaye. Main bhi gaya, aap ke chehre par nazrein padte hi main ne samajh liya ki yeh chehra kisi jhoote aadmi ka nahi. Paas gaya to sab se pehle aap ki zubaan-e-mubarak se yeh kalam suna ke logo salam phailao, khana khilate raha karo. Sila-e-rahmi qaim rakho. Raaton ko logon ki neend ke waqt tahajjud ki namaz padha karo to salamati ke sath jannat mein jaoge. Isi tarah jab Saad bin Bakr ke qabeele ke wafad mein Zumam bin Thalaba R.A aap ki khidmat mein hazir hue to pucha ke is aasman ka buland karne wala kaun hai? Aap ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala hai. Usne pucha in pahadon ka gaadhne wala kaun hai? Aap ne farmaya Allah. Usne pucha is zameen ka phailane wala kaun hai? Aap ne farmaya Allah. To usne kaha main aap ko usi Allah ki qasam deta hoon jis ne in asmaano ko buland kiya, in pahadon ko gaad diya, is zameen ko phaila diya ke kya waqai Allah Ta'ala hi ne aap ko apna rasul bana kar hamari taraf bheja hai? Aap ne farmaya haan, usi Allah ki qasam, haan. Isi tarah namaz, zakat, hajj aur rozey ki baabat bhi usne aisi hi takeedi qasam dila kar sawal kiya aur aap ne bhi qasam kha kar jawab diya. Tab usne kaha aap ﷺ sache hain. Usi ki qasam jis ne aap ko haq ke sath bheja hai ke na main is par badhaunga aur na kam karunga. Pas is shakhs ne sirf isi par qanaat kar li aur jo dalail aap ki sadaqat ke uske samne the un par use aitbaar aa gaya. Hazrat Hassan ne aap ki tareef mein kitna achha sher kaha hai:
Lo lam takun fihi ayatun mubayyinatun, kanat badihatuhu tatika bil-khairi
Yaani Huzoor ﷺ mein agar aur zahir aur khuli nishaniyan na bhi hotin to sirf yahi ek baat kafi thi ki chehra dekhte hi bhalai aur khubi teri taraf lapakti hai. Faslawatullahi wa salamuhu alaih. Barkhilaf aap ke kazaab Musailama ke jis ne use ek nigah dekh liya uska jhoot us par khul gaya.

Khususan jis ne us ke fazool aqwal aur bad-tareen afaal dekh liye. Usay us ke jhoot mein zara sa shaiba bhi na raha. Jisay woh Allah ka kalam keh raha tha us kalam ki bad-mazgi, us ki be-kari, toh itni zahir hai ke kalam ke samne pesh kiye jane ke bhi kabil nahi. Lo ab tum hi insaaf karo. Ayatul Kursi ke muqabale mein is maloon ne yeh ayat banai thi. Ya zifda'u binta zifda'in naqi kam tanqina la lil-ma'a takudurina wa la ash-shari-a tamna'ina yani aiy mandakon ke bachche main mandak tu tarata reh. Na tu pani kharab kar sake na pine walon ko rok sake. Is tarah us ke napak kalam ke namune mein us ki banai ek aur ayat hai ke Laqad an'amal-lahu 'alal-jabali iza kharaja minha nasmatun tas'a min baini siffaqin wa wahshin Allah ne hamla par bari meharbani farmai ke us ke pet se chalti phirti jaan baramad ki, jhali aur anton ke darmiyan se. Surah Al-Fil ke mukabale mein woh paji kehta hai Al-filu wa ma adraka mal-filu lahu khurtumun tawil yani hathi aur kya jaane tu kya hai hathi ? Is ki bari lambi sondh hoti hai. Wan-nazi'at ka mu'araza karte hue yeh kamina kehta hai Wal-'ajinatu 'ajnan wal-khabizatu khabzan wal-aqimatu luqman ahalata wa sam'an inna quraishan qawmun ya'tadoon yani aata goondhne wala aur roti pakaane waliyan, aur luqme banane waliyan, salan aur ghee se. Quraish log bahut aage nikal gaye. Ab aap hi insaaf kijiye ke yeh bachchon ka khel hai ya nahi ? Shareef insaan toh siwaye mazak ke aisi baat munh se bhi nahi nikal sakta phir us ka anjam dekhiye larai mein mara gaya. Us ka giroh mit gaya. Us ke sathiyon par lanat barsi. Hazrat Siddiq-e-Akbar ke paas khaib-o-khasir ho kar munh par mitti mal kar pesh hue aur ro dho kar tauba kar ke joon joon kar ke jaan bachai. Phir toh Allah ke sachche deen ki chashni se hont chosne lage. Ek roz un se Khalifatul Muslimeen Amirul Mumineen Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq ؓ ne kaha ke Musailimah ka Quran toh sunao toh bahut sat-pitaye bihad sharmaye aur kehne lage Hazrat hamein is napak kalam ke zaban se nikalne par majboor na kijiye hamein toh is se sharm maloom hoti hai. Aap ne farmaya nahi to zaroor sunao taake hamare musalman bhaiyon ko bhi us ki rakakat aur behudgi maloom ho jaye. Aakhir majboor ho kar unhon ne nihayat hi sharmate hue kuch parha jis ka namuna upar guzra ke kahin mein mandak ka zikr kahin hathi ka kahin roti ka kahin haml ka. Aur woh sare hi zikr be-sood be-maza aur be-kaar. Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq ؓ ne aakhir mein farmaya yeh toh batao tumhari aqlein kahan mari gayin thin ? Wallahu isay toh koi bewqoof bhi ek lamhe ke liye Kalamullah nahi keh sakta. Mazkoor hai ki 'Amr bin Al-'As apne kufr ke zamane mein Musailimah ke paas pahuncha. Yeh dono bachpan ke dost thay is se pucha kaho 'Amr tumhare haan ke nabi par aaj kal jo wahi utri ho us mein se kuch suna sakte ho ?

Usne kaha haan un ke ashab ek mukhtasar surat padhte the jo meri zaban par bhi chadh gayi lekin bhai apne mazmun ke lihaz se woh surat bahut badi aur bahut hi aala hai aur lafzon ke aitbar se bahut hi mukhtasar aur badi jami hai. Phir us ne Surah Al-Asr padh sunai. Musailmah chupka ho gaya bahut der ke baad kehne laga mujh par isi jaisi surat utri hai. Us ne kaha haan tu bhi suna de toh us ne padha Ya wabru ya wabru innama anta uznan wa sadrun wa sairuka haqirun laghir yaani ae wabru janwar tere toh bas do kaan hain aur seena hai, aur baaki jism toh tera bilkul haqir aur aib-dar hai. Yeh suna kar Amr se poochta hai kaho dost kaisi kahi? Us ne kaha dost apne jhoot par mohar laga di aur kaisi kahi? Pas jab ke ek mushrik par bhi sache jhoote ki tameez mushkil na hui toh ek sahib-e-aql tameez-dar aur ba-iman par kaise yeh baat chhup sakti hai? Is ka bayan (Wa man azlamu mimmanif-tara 'alal-lahi kaziban aw qala uhiya ilayya wa lam yuha ilaihi shay'un) [6. Al-An'am: 93] mein hai yaani Allah par jhoot iftra karne wale ya us ki taraf wahi na aane ke bawajود wahi aane ka dawa karne wale se badh kar zalim koi nahi. Isi tarah jo kahe ke main bhi Allah ki tarah ka kalam utar sakta hu. Mundarja bala ayat mein bhi yahi farman hai. Pas woh bada hi zalim hai jo Allah par jhoot bandhe, woh bada hi zalim hai jo Allah ki ayton ko jhutlaye. Hujjat zahir ho jane par bhi na maane. Hadith mein hai sab se bada sarkash aur bad-naseeb woh hai jo kisi nabi ko qatal kare ya nabi use qatal kare.

Shirk ke aaghaz ki rodaad: Mushrikin ka khayal tha ke jin ko hum poojte hain yeh Allah ke haan hamare sifarishi honge. Is ghalat aqeedah ki Quran-e-Kareem tardeed farmata hai ke woh kisi nafa-nuqsaan ka ikhtiyar nahi rakhte, un ki shafahat tumhare kuch kaam na aaye gi. Tum to Allah ko bhi sikhana chahte ho, goya jo cheez zameen aasman mein hai woh nahi janta, tum us ki khabar use dena chahte ho? 

Yaani yeh khayal ghalat hai. Allah Ta'ala shirk-o-kufr se paak hai, woh bartar-o-bari hai. Suno, pehle sab ke sab log Islam par thay. Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam / A.S) se le kar Hazrat Noh (Alaihis Salam / A.S) tak das sadiyan woh sab log musalman thay. Phir ikhtilaf ronuma hua aur logon ne gheron ki parastish shuru kar di. 

Allah Ta'ala ne rasoolon ke silsiloon ko jari kiya taake suboot-o-daleel ke baad jis ka jee chahe zinda rahe, jis ka jee chahe mar jaye. Choonke Allah ki taraf se faisle ka din muqarrar hai, hujjat tamam karne se pehle azaab nahi hota, is liye maut moakhar hai. Warna abhi hi hisab chuka diya jata, momin kamyab rehte aur kafir nakaam.

Subut-e-Sadaqat mangne wale kehte hain ki agar yeh sachha Nabi hai toh jaise Aal-e-Samud ko untni mili thi inhein aisi koi nishani kyun nahi mili? Chahiye tha ki yeh Safa Pahar ko sona bana deta ya Makkah ke paharon ko hata kar yahan khetiyan, baagh aur nehrein bana deta. Go Allah ki qudrat isse aajiz nahi lekin iski hikmat ka taqaza wahi janta hai. Agar woh chahe toh apne Nabi ﷺ ke liye baagh aur nehrein bana de lekin yeh phir bhi Qiyamat ke munkir hi rahenge aur aakhir Jahannam mein jayenge. Aglon ne bhi aise mojize talab kiye, dikhaye gaye phir bhi jhutlaya toh azaab-e-Ilahi aa gaye. Aan-Hazrat ﷺ se bhi yehi farmaya gaya tha ki agar tum chaho toh main inke munh mange mojize dikha dun lekin phir bhi yeh kafir rahe toh ghaarat kar diye jayenge aur agar chaho toh mohlat dun. Aap ne apne hilm-o-karam se dusri baat hi ikhtiyar ki. Yahan hukm hota hai ki ghaib ka ilm Allah hi ko hai, tamam kaamo ka anjam wahi janta hai. Tum iman nahi laate toh natije ke muntazir raho. Dekho mera kya hota hai aur tumhara kya hota hai? Ah! Kaise bad-naseeb the jo mangte the isse badarja barh kar dekh chuke the aur sab mojizon ko jaane do, chand ko ek ishare se do tukre kar dena, ek tukre ka Pahar ke us taraf aur dusre ka us taraf chale aana, kya yeh mojiza kis tarah aur kis mojize se kam tha? Lekin chunke inka yeh sawal mahz kufr ki bina par tha warna yeh bhi Allah dikha deta. Jin par azaab amlan aa jata hai, woh chahe duniya bhar ke mojize dekh lein inhein iman naseeb nahi hota. Agar in par farishte utarte, agar inse murde baatein karte, agar har ek cheez inke samne kar di jati phir bhi inhein toh iman naseeb na hota. Isi ka bayan (Walaaw fatahna alayhim baban minas-samaa'i fazallu fihi ya'rujun) (Surah Al-Hijr: 14-15) aur aayat wa in yaraw kisfan minas-samaa' i al-ayah, aur aayat (Walaaw nazzalna alayka kitaban fi qirtasin falamusuhu bi-aydihim laqalal-lazina kafaru in haza illa sihrun mubin) (Surah Al-An'am: 7) mein bhi hua hai. Pas aise logon ko inke munh mange mojize dikhane bhi be-sud hain. Isliye ki unhon ne toh kufr par girah laga li hai. Isliye farma diya ki aage chal kar dekh lena ki kya hota hai.

Ahsan Faramosh Insan

Insan ki nashukri ka bayan ho raha hai ke use sakhti ke baad ki asani, khushksali ke baad ki tarsali, qahat ke baad ki barish aur bhi nashukra kar deti hai, yeh hamari aayaton se mazak udane lagta hai. Kya tu us waqt hamari taraf unka jhukna aur kya us waqt unka akadna. Raat ko barish hui, subah ko Huzoor ﷺ ne namaz padhai, phir pucha jaante bhi ho raat ko Bari Ta'ala ne kya farmaya hai? Sahaba ne kaha humein kya khabar? Aap ne farmaya Allah ka irshad hua hai ke subah ko mere bahut se bande imandar ho jayenge aur bahut se kafir. Kuch kahenge ke Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam aur uske lutf-o-rahm se barish hui woh mujh par iman rakhne wale ban jayenge aur sitaron ki aisi tasiron ke munkar ho jayenge aur kuch kahenge ke flan flan nakhstar ki wajah se barish barsai gayi woh mujh se kafir ho jayenge aur sitaron par iman rakhne wale ban jayenge. Yahan farmata hai ke jaise yeh chalbazi unki taraf se hai, main bhi uske jawab se ghafil nahi, unhein dheel deta hoon. Yeh ise ghaflat samajhte hain phir jab pakad aa jati hai toh hairan-o-shashdar reh jaate hain. Main ghafil nahi. Main ne toh apne amain farishte chhod rakhe hain jo unke kartoot barabar likhte ja rahe hain. Phir mere saamne pesh karenge, main khud dana bina hoon, lekin taham woh sab tehrir mere saamne hogi, jismein unke chhote bade bhale sab aamal honge. Isi Allah ki hifazat mein tumhare khushki aur tari ke safar hote hain. Tum kashtiyon mein sawar ho, muwafiq hawayein chal rahi hain, kashtiyan teer ki tarah manzil-e-maqsud ko ja rahi hain, tum khushiyan mana rahe ho ke yakayak baad-e-mukhalif chali aur charon taraf se pahadoun ki tarah maujein uth khadi huin. Samandar mein talatum shuru ho gaya, kashti tinke ki tarah jhakole khane lagi aur tumhare kalije ulatne lage. Har taraf se maut nazar aane lagi, us waqt sare bane banaye ma'bud apni jagah dhare reh gaye aur nihayat khushu-o-khuzu se sirf mujh se duayein mangi jane lagin, wade kiye jane lage ke ab ke is museebat se nijat mil jaane ke baad shukr guzari mein baaki umr guzar denge, tauheed mein lage rahenge, kisi ko Allah ka shareek nahi banayenge, aaj se khalis tauba hai. Lekin udhar nijat mili, kinare par utre, khushki mein chale phire ke is museebat ke waqt ko, is khalis dua ko, phir iqrar-e-shukr-o-tauheed ko yaksar bhool gaye aur aise ho gaye goya hamein kabhi pukara hi na tha, hum se kabhi mamla hi na pada tha. Nahaq akad-fon karne lage, masti mein aa gaye. Logo! Tumhari is sarkashi ka wabaal tum par hi hai. Tum is se dusron ka nahi balke apna hi nuksan kar rahe ho. Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain woh gunah jis par yahan bhi Allah ki pakad nazil ho aur aakhir mein bhi badtareen azaab ho, fasad-o-sarkashi aur qat-e-rahmi se badh kar koi nahi. Tum is duniyaye fani ke thode se baraye naam fayde ko chahe utha lo lekin aakhir anjam toh meri taraf hi hai. Mere saamne aaoge, mere qabze mein hoge.

Us waqt hum khud tumhe tumhari bad-a'maliyon par mutanbih karenge, har ek ko uske a'maal ka badla denge, lehaza achhai pakar hamara shukr karo aur burai dekh kar apne sawa kisi aur ko malamat aur ilzam na do.

Duniya aur us ki haqeeqat. Duniya ki teep-top aur us ki do ghari ki suhani raunaq phir us ki barbadi aur be-raunaqi ki misaal zameen ke sabze se di ja rahi hai ke baadal se pani barsa zameen lahlaha uthi. Tarah tarah ki sabziyan, chaare, phal phool, khet baagat, paida ho gaye. Insanon ke khane ki cheezein, janwaron ke charne chagne ki cheezein, charon taraf phail padin, zameen sarsabz ho gayi, har chahar taraf hariyali hi hariyali nazar aane lagi, kheti wale khush ho gaye, baagat wale phule nahi samate ke ab ke phal aur anaj bakasrat hai. Nagahan aandhiyon ke jhakad chalne lage, barf bari hui, ole gire, pala pada, phal chhor patte bhi jal gaye. Darakht jadon se ukhad gaye, tazgi khushki se badal gayi, phal thuthar gaye, jal gaye, khet o baagat aise ho gaye goya the hi nahi aur jo cheez kal thi bhi aaj nahi toh goya kal bhi na thi. Hadith mein hai bade duniyadar crore pati ko jo hamesha naz o nemat mein hi raha tha, la kar jahannam mein ek ghota de kar phir us se pucha jayega ke kaho tumhari zindagi kaisi guzri ? Woh jawab dega ke main ne toh kabhi koi rahat nahi dekhi. Kabhi aaram ka naam bhi nahi suna. Isi tarah duniya ki zindagi mein ek ghari bhi jis par aaram ki nahi guzri thi use laya jayega. Jannat mein ek ghota khila kar pucha jayega ke kaho duniya mein kaise rahe ? Jawab dega ke poori umr kabhi ranj o gham ka naam bhi nahi suna kabhi takleef aur dukh dekha bhi nahi. Allah Ta'ala isi tarah aqalmandon ke liye waqiyat wazih karta hai taake woh ibrat hasil kar lein. Aisa na ho is fani chand roza duniya ke zahiri chakkar mein phans jayein aur is dhal jaane wale saaye ko asli aur payidar samajh lein. Is ki raunaq do roza hai. Yeh woh cheez hai jo apne chahne walon se bhagti hai. Aur nafrat karne walon se lipti hai. Duniya ki zindagi ki misaal isi tarah hai aur bhi bahut si ayaton mein bayaan hui hai. Masalan Surah Kahf ki (Wadrib lahum masalal-hayatid-dunya kama'in anzalnahu minas-sama'i fakhtalata bihi nabatul-ardi fa-asbaha hashiyman tazruhur-riyah, wa kanallahu 'ala kulli shay'in muqtadira) (Surah Al-Kahf: 45) mein aur Surah Zumar aur Surah Hadid mein. Khalifa Marwan bin Hakam ne mimbar par (Wa zanna ahluha annahum qadirun) (Surah Yunus: 24) padh kar farmaya main ne toh isi tarah padhi hai lekin Quran mein yeh likhi hui nahi Hazrat Ibn Abbas ke sahabzade ne farmaya mere walid bhi isi tarah padhte the. Ibn Abbas ke paas jab aadmi bheja gaya toh aap ne farmaya Ubayy bin Ka'b ki qirat bhi yunhi hai. Lekin yeh qirat ghareeba hai. Aur goya yeh jumla tafsiriyah hai Wallahu A'lam. Allah Ta'ala salamati ke ghar ki taraf apne bandon ko bulata hai jo duniya ki tarah fani nahi balki baqi hai duniya ki tarah do din ke liye zeenat dar nahi balki hamesha ki nematon aur abadi rahaton wali hai.

Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhse kaha gaya teri aankhein so jaayein, tera dil jaagta rahe aur tere kaan sunte rahein chunancha aisa hi hua. Phir farmaya gaya ek sardar ne ek ghar banaya. Wahan dawat ka intezam kiya. Ek bulane wale ko bheja. Pas jis ne uski dawat قبول (qubool) ki, ghar mein dakhil hua aur dastarkhwan se khana khaya, jis ne na qubool ki na use apne ghar mein aata mila na dawat ka khana mayassar hua na sardar us se khush hua. Pas Allah sardar hai aur ghar Islam hai aur dastarkhwan Jannat hai aur bulane wale Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain, yeh riwayat Mursal hai. Dusri Muttasil bhi hai. Is mein hai ki ek din hamare majma mein aakar Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya khwab mein mere paas Jibreel-o-Mikaeel aaye, Jibreel sarhane aur Mikaeel pairon ki taraf khade ho gaye. Ek ne dusre se kaha iski misaal bayan karo. Phir yeh misaal bayan ki. Pas jis ne teri dawat qubool ki woh Islam mein dakhil hua aur jo Islam laya woh Jannat mein pahuncha aur wahan khaya piya. Ek hadith mein hai har din suraj ke tulu hone ke waqt uske dono jaanib do farishte hote hain jo ba-aawaz buland insano aur jino ke siwa sab ko suna kar kehte hain ke logo! Apne Rab ki taraf aao. Jo kam ho ya kafi ho woh behtar hai us se jo zyada ho aur ghafil karde. Quran farmata hai logo! Allah Ta'ala tumhe Darussalam ki taraf bulata hai (Ibn Abi Hatim aur Ibn Jarir).

Is ke siva sab kuch baatil hai. Pas tumhen is ki ibadat se hat kar auron ki ibadat ki taraf na jana chahiye yaad rakho wahi Rabb-ul-Alamin hai wahi har cheez mein mutasarif hai. Apni badbakhti ki wajah se jahannam ki taraf barhte ja rahe hain. Unhen iman naseeb nahi hoga.

Masnui Ma'budon ki Haqeeqat

Mushrikin ke shirk ki tardid ho rahi hai ke batlao tumhare ma'budon mein se ek bhi aisa hai jo aasmanon-o-zamin ko aur makhluq ko paida kar sake ya bigad kar bana sake, na ibtida par koi qadir na a'adah par koi qadir. Balki Allah hi ibtida kare wohi a'adah kare. Woh apne tamam kamon mein yakta hai. Pas tum tariq-e-haq se ghum kar rah-e-zalalat ki taraf kyun ja rahe ho? Kaho to tumhare ma'bud kisi bhatke hue ki rahbari kar sakte hain? Yeh bhi un ke bas ki baat nahi balki yeh bhi Allah ke hath mein hai. Hadi-e-barhaq wohi hai, wohi gumraahon ko rah-e-rast dikhata hai, us ke siva koi sathi nahi. Pas jo rahbari to kya kare khud hi andha behra ho us ki tabadari theek ya us ki ita'at achhi jo sacha hadi malik-e-kul qadir-e-kul ho? Yeh Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah ne apne baap se kaha tha ke un ki puja kyun karta hai? Jo na sune na dekhein na koi faida de sakein. Apni kaum se farmate hain ke tum un ki puja karte ho jinhe khud apne hathon banate ho. Halanki tumhara aur tumhare kaam ki tamam cheezon ka paida karne wala Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Yahan farmata hai tumhari aqlein kya andhi ho gain ke khaliq-o-makhluq ko ek kar diya, neki se hat kar badi mein ja gare, tauhid ko chhod kar shirk mein phans gaye. Is ko aur is ko pujne lage. Rabb-e-Jal Jalaluhu malik-o-hakim-o-hadi-o-rab se bhatak gaye. Us ki taraf khulus-e-dili tawajjo chhod di. Daleel-o-burhan se hat gaye, moghalton aur taqlid mein phans gaye. Guman aur atkal ke peeche pad gaye. Vahm-o-khayal ke bhanwar mein aa gaye, halanki zun-o-guman fazool cheez hai. Haq ke samne woh mahz bekar hai tumhein is se koi faida pahunch nahi sakta. Allah Ta'ala aise logon ke a'maal se bakhabar hai woh unhe poori saza dega.

I'jaz-e-Quran-e-Hakim
Quran-e-Karim ke i'jaz ka aur Quran-e-Karim ke Kalamullah hone ka bayan ho raha hai ki koi is ka badal aur muqabla nahi kar sakta. Is jaisa Quran balke is jaisi das suratein balke ek surat bhi kisi ke bas ki nahi. Yeh bemisal Quran bemisal Allah ki taraf se hai. Is ki fasahat-o-balaghat, is ki wajahat-o-halawat, is ke ma'ano ki bulandi, is ke mazamin ki umdagi bilkul benazir cheez hai. Aur yahi daleel hai is ki ki yeh Quran us Allah ki taraf سے hai jis ki zat bemisal, sifatein bemisal, jis ke aqwal bemisal, jis ke afwal bemisal, jis ka kalam us cheez se aali aur buland ki makhlooq ka kalam us ke mushabeh ho sake. Yeh kalam to Rabb-ul-Alamin ka hi kalam hai, na koi aur ise bana sake, na yeh kisi aur ka banaya hua. Yeh to sabqa kitabon ki tasdeeq karta hai, un par nighebani karta hai, un ka izhar karta hai, un mein jo tehreef, tabdeel, taweel hui hai ise behijab karta hai, halal-o-haram, jaiz-o-najaiz gharz kul umoor-e-shara' ka shafi aur poora bayan farmata hai. Pas is ke Kalamullah hone mein koi shak-o-shubah nahi. 

Hazrat Ali R.A se marwi hai is mein agli khabrein hain, is mein aane wali peshgoiyan hain aur aane wali khabrein hain. Sab jhagre ke faisle hain, sab ahkaam ke hukm hain. Agar tumhein is ke Kalamullah hone mein shak hai, to ise ghada hua samajhte ho aur kehte ho ki Muhammad ﷺ ne apni taraf se keh liya hai, to jao tum sab mil kar ek hi surat is jaisi bana lao aur kul insan aur jino se madad bhi le lo. Yeh teesra maqam hai jahan kuffar ko muqabale par bula kar aajiz kiya gaya hai ki agar woh apne dawe mein sache hon to is ke muqabale mein usi jaisa kalam pesh karein. Lekin yeh hai namumkin, yeh khabar bhi sath hi de di thi ki insan-o-jinnaat sab jama ho jayein, ek dusre ka sath dein, lekin is Quran jaisa bana kar pesh nahi kar sakte. 

Is poore Quran ke muqabale se jab woh aajiz-o-lachar sabit ho chuke to un se mutaliba hua ki is jaisi sirf das suratein hi bana kar lao. Surah Hud ke shuru ki (QUL FA'TOU BI-'ASHRI SUWARIN MITHLIHI MUFTARAYATIN WAD'OU MAN ISTATA'TUM MIN DUNILLAHI IN KUNTUM SADIQIN 13) (11. Hud: 13) mein yeh farman hai. Jab yeh bhi un se na ho saka to aur asani kar di gayi aur Surah Baqarah mein jo Madani hai farmaya ki acha ek hi surat is jaisi bana kar pesh karo. Wahan bhi sath hi farmaya ki na yeh tumhare bas ki baat hai na sari makhlooq ke bas ki baat hai. Pas is ilhami kitab ko jhutla kar azab-e-Ilahi mol na lo. 

Us waqt kalam ki fasahat-o-balaghat par poora zor tha. Arab apne muqabale mein sare jahan ko Ajam ya'ni gonga kaha karte the. Apni zaban par bara ghamand tha, is liye Allah Ta'ala ne woh Quran utara ki sab se pehle unhin shaayiron aur zaban-danon aur aalamon ki gardanein is ke samne kham huin jaise sab se pehle Hazrat Musa A.S ke is mojaze ne ki murdon ko bi-hukm-e-Ilahi jala dena.

Mader-zad andhon aur korhiyon ko behukm-e-Rabb shifa de dena, duniya ke sab se pehle moalijon aur atibba ko Allah ki rah par la khara kar diya. Kyunke unhon ne dekh liya ke yeh kaam dawa ka nahi Allah ka hai. Jadu-garon ne saanp ko jo Hazrat Musa (A.S) ki lakri thi dekhte hi Aap ki nubuwwat ka yaqin kar liya aur aajiz-o-darmanda ho gaye. Isi tarah is Quran ne faseeh-o-baleeh logon ki zabaan-e-band kar dien. Unke dilon mein yaqin aa gaya ke beshak yeh kalaam insan ka kalaam nahi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain nabiyon ko aise mojize diye gaye ke unki wajah se log un par iman laye. Mera aisa mojiza Quran hai pas mujhe ummeed hai ke mere tabiadar ba-nisbat unke bahut hi zyada honge. Yeh (kafir) log baghair soche samjhe, baghair ilm hasil kiye ise jhutlane lage. Ab tak to iske misdaq aur haqeeqat tak bhi yeh nahi pohnche. Apni jahalat-o-safahat ki wajah se iski hidayat iske ilm se mehroom reh gaye aur chalana shuru kar diya ke hum ise nahi mante. Uske aakhir mein hai aye mere bando! Yeh toh tumhare apne amaal hain jinhe main jama kar raha hoon phir tumhe unka badla doonga. Pas jo shakhs bhalai paye woh Allah ka shukr baja laye aur jo uske siva kuch aur paye woh sirf apne nafs ko hi malamat kare (Muslim).

Mushrikeen se ijtinab farma lijiye. Farman hota hai ke aye Nabi ﷺ agar yeh mushrikeen tujhe jhoota hi batlate rahein toh tu unke aur unke kaamo se apni bezari ka elaan karde. Aur keh de ke tumhare amaal tumhare saath mere amaal mere saath. Jaise ke woh Surah (Aayat Qul Ya Ayyuhal Kafirun) mein bayaan hua hai aur jaise ke Hazrat Khalilullah aur aap ke sathiyo ne apni kaum se farmaya tha ke hum tum se aur tumhare maboodo se bezaar hain jinhe tum ne Allah ke siva apna mabood bana rakha hai. Un mein se baaz tera pakeeza kalaam bhi sunte hain aur khud Allah Ta'ala ka buland-o-bala kalaam bhi unke kaano mein par raha hai. Yeh dil ke kaan nahi rakhte. Allah hi ke haath hidayat hai. Yeh tujhe dekhte hain, tere pakeeza akhlaq, teri suthri taleem, teri nubuwat ki roshan daleelein har waqt unke samne hain lekin unse bhi unhe koi faida nahi pahunchta. Jab sab apni qabar se uthenge!
Bayan ho raha hai ke woh waqt bhi aa raha hai jab qiyamat qaim hogi aur logon ko Allah Ta'ala un ki qabron se utha kar maidan-e-qiyamat mein jama karega. Us waqt unhein aisa maloom hoga ke goya ghari bhar din hum rahe hain. Subah ya sham hi tak hamara rehna huwa tha. Kahenge ke das roz duniya mein guzare honge. To bare bare hafize wale kahenge kahan ke das din tum to ek hi din rahe. 
Qiyamat ke din yeh qasemein kha kha kar kahenge ke ek saat hi rahe waghera. Aisi aayetein Quran-e-Kareem mein bohat si hain. Maqsood yeh hai ke duniya ki zindagi aaj bohat thori maloom hogi. Sawaal hoga ke kitne saal duniya mein guzare, jawab denge ke ek din balke isay bhi kam, shumar walon se pooch lo. Jawab milega ke waqia mein dar-e-duniya dar-e-akhirat ke muqable mein bohat hi kam hai aur fi-l-haqeeqat wahan ki zindagi bohat hi thori thi lekin tum ne is ka khayal zindagi bhar na kiya. 
Us waqt bhi har ek doosre ko pehchanta hoga jaise duniya mein the waise hi wahan bhi honge. Rishte konbe ko, baap beton ko alag alag pehchan lenge. Lekin har ek nafsa-nafsi mein mashghool hoga. Jaise farman-e-ilahi hai ke soor ke phoonkte hi hasb-o-nasab fana ho jayenge. Koi dost apne kisi dost se kuch sawaal tak na karega. 
Jo is din ko jhutlate rahe woh aaj ghate mein rahenge, un ke liye halakat hogi, unhon ne apna hi bura kiya aur apne walon ko bhi barbad kiya. Is se barh kar khasara aur kya hoga ke ek doosre se door hai, doston ke darmiyan tafreeq hai, hasrat-o-nadamat ka din hai.

Allah Ta'ala Muqtadir-e-Aala hai. Farman hai ke agar teri zindagi mein hum in kuffar par koi azaab utaarein ya tujhe in azaabon ke utaarne se pehle hi apne paas bula lein, behar-surat hai toh yeh sab hamare qabze mein hi aur thikana in ka hamare haan hi hai aur hum par in ka koi amal poshida nahi. 

Tabarani ki hadith mein hai ke ek martaba Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya: Guzishta raat isi hujre ke paas mere saamne meri saari ummat pesh ki gayi. Kisi ne pucha ke achcha, maujuda log toh khair lekin jo abhi tak paida nahi hue, woh kaise pesh kiye gaye? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: In ke mitti ke jism pesh kiye gaye, jaise tum apne kisi sathi ko pehchante ho, aise hi main ne unhein pehchan liya. 

Har ummat ke rasool hain. Jab kisi ke paas rasool pahunch gaya, phir hujjat poori ho gayi. Ab Qiyamat ke din un ke darmiyan adl-o-insaaf ke sath baghair kisi zulm ke hisab chuka diya jayega. Jaise (Wa ashraqatil-ardu bi-nuri rabbiha wa wudi'al-kitabu wa ji'a bin-nabiyyina wash-shuhada'i wa qudiya bainahum bil-haqqi wa hum la yuzlamun) (Surah Az-Zumar: 69) wali ayat mein hai. 

Har ummat Allah ke saamne hogi, rasool maujuda hoga, namah-e-amal sath hoga, gawah farishte hazir honge, ek ke baad dusri ummat aayegi. Is sharif ummat ka faisla sab se pehle hoga, go duniya mein yeh sab se aakhir mein aayi hai. 

Bukhari o Muslim ki hadith mein hai, Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain: Hum sab se aakhir mein aaye hain lekin Qiyamat ke din sab se pehle honge, hamare faisle sab se awwal honge. Apne Nabi ﷺ ki fazilat aur sharaf ki wajah se yeh ummat bhi Allah ke haan sharif aur afzal hai.

Be-mani sawal karne walon ko jawab un ka be-faida sawal dekho. Wada ka din kab aayega? Yeh poochte hain aur phir woh bhi na manne aur inkar ke baad batour yeh jaldi macha rahe hain aur momin khof-zada ho rahe hain kyunke woh jaante hain. Waqt na maloom ho na sahi jaante hain ke baat sachi hai ek din aayega zaroori. Hidayat di jati hai ke unhein jawab de ke mere ikhtiyar mein to koi baat nahi. Jo baat mujhe batla di jaye main to wohi jaanta hoon. Kisi cheez ki mujh mein qudrat nahi yahan tak ke khud apne nafa nuksan ka bhi main malik nahi. Main to Allah ka ghulam hoon aur is ka Rasul ﷺ hoon. Us ne mujh se farmaya main ne tum se kaha ke qayamat aayegi zaroor. Na us ne mujhe is ka khas waqt bataya na main tumhein bata sakon haan har zamane ki ek miyad mairn hai jahan ajal aayi phir na ek sahat peeche na aage ajal aane ke baad nahi rukti. Phir farmaya ke woh to achanak aane wali hai mumkin hai raat ko aa jaye din ko aa jaye is ke azab mein dair kya hai? Phir is shor machane se aur waqt ka taayun poochne se kya hasil? Kya jab qayamat aa jaye azab dekh lo tab iman laoge? Woh mahz be-sood hai. Us waqt to yeh sab kahenge ke hum ne dekh sun liya. Kahenge hum Allah par iman late hain aur dusre se kufr karte hain. Lekin hamare azab ko dekhne ke baad iman be-nafa hai. Allah ka tareeqa apne bandon mein yahi raha hai wahan to kafiron ko nuksan hi rahega. Us din to un se saf keh diya jayega aur bahut dant dupt ke sath ke ab to daimi azab chakho, hamesha ki museebat uthao. Unhein dhakke de de kar jahannam mein jhonk diya jayega ke yeh hai jise tum nahi mante the. Ab batao ke yeh jadoo hai ya tum andhe ho? Jao ab is mein chale jao ab to sabr karna na karna barabar hai apne aamal ka badla zaroor paoge.

Mitti hone ke baad jeena kaisa hai ? Puchte hain ki kya mitti hojane aur sad gal jane ke baad ji uthna aur qayamat ka qayim hona haq hi hai ? Toh unka shuba mita de aur qasam kha kar keh de ki yeh sarasar haq hi hai. Jis Allah ne tumhein us waqt paida kiya jab ki tum kuch na the. Woh tumhein dobarah jab ki tum mitti hojaoge paida karne par yaqinan qadir hai woh toh jo chahta hai farma deta hai ki yun hoja usi waqt hojata hai isi mazmoon ki aur do aayatein Quran-e-Kareem mein hain. Surah Saba mein hai (Qul bala wa Rabbi la-ta'tiyannakum) (34. Saba: 3) Surah Taghabun mein hai (Qul bala wa Rabbi la-tub'athunna thumma la-tunabba'unna bima amiltum) (64. At-Taghabun: 7) In dono mein bhi qayamat ke hone par qasam kha kar yaqeen dilaya gaya hai. Us din toh kuffar zameen bhar kar sona apne badle mein de kar bhi chhutkara pana pasand karenge. Dilon mein nidamat hogi, azaab samne honge, haq ke sath faisle ho rahe honge, kisi par zulm hargiz na hoga.

Rasool ﷺ Kareem ke mansab-e-azeem ka tazkira:

Apne Rasool ﷺ Kareem par Quran-e-Azeem nazil farmaney ke ehsan ko Allah Rabb-ul-Izzat bayan farma rahey hain ki Allah ka waiz tumhare paas aa chuka jo tumhein badiyon se rok raha hai, jo dilon ke shak-o-shukook door karney wala hai, jis se hidayat hasil hoti hai, jis se Allah ki rahmat milti hai. Jo is sachai ki tasdeeq karein usay maanein, is par yaqeen rakhein, is par iman layein woh is se nafa hasil karte hain. Yeh hamara nazil karda Quran momino ke liye shifa aur rahmat hai, zalim toh apney nuqsan mein hi barhtey rehtey hain. Aur aayat mein hai ki keh dey ki yeh toh imandaro ke liye hidayat aur shifa hai. Allah ke fazl-o-rahmat yani is Quran ke sath khush hona chahiye. Dunya-e-fani ke dhan daulat par reejh janey aur is par shadman-o-farhan hojaney se toh is daulat ko hasil karney aur is abadi khushi aur daimi masarrat ko paleney se bohat khush hona chahiye. Ibn Abi Hatim aur Tabarani mein hai ki jab Iraq fateh hogaya aur wahan se kharaj Darbar-e-Farooqi mein pohncha toh aap ne oonton ki ginti karna chahi lekin woh beshumar thay. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne Allah Ta'ala ka shukr ada kar ke isi aayat ki tilawat ki. Toh aap se Maula Amr ne kaha yeh bhi toh Allah ka fazl-o-rahmat hi hai. Aap ne farmaya tum ne ghalat kaha yeh tumhare hamare hasil karda hain, jis fazl-o-rahmat ka bayan is aayat mein hai woh yeh nahi.

Jo is sachai ki tasdeeq karein usay maanein, is par yaqeen rakhein, is par iman layein woh is se nafa hasil karte hain. Yeh hamara nazil karda Quran momino ke liye shifa aur rahmat hai, zalim toh apney nuqsan mein hi barhtey rehtey hain. Aur aayat mein hai ki keh dey ki yeh toh imandaro ke liye hidayat aur shifa hai. Allah ke fazl-o-rahmat yani is Quran ke sath khush hona chahiye. Dunya-e-fani ke dhan daulat par reejh janey aur is par shadman-o-farhan hojaney se toh is daulat ko hasil karney aur is abadi khushi aur daimi masarrat ko paleney se bohat khush hona chahiye. Ibn Abi Hatim aur Tabarani mein hai ki jab Iraq fateh hogaya aur wahan se kharaj Darbar-e-Farooqi mein pohncha toh aap ne oonton ki ginti karna chahi lekin woh beshumar thay. Hazrat Umar (R.A) ne Allah Ta'ala ka shukr ada kar ke isi aayat ki tilawat ki. Toh aap se Maula Amr ne kaha yeh bhi toh Allah ka fazl-o-rahmat hi hai. Aap ne farmaya tum ne ghalat kaha yeh tumhare hamare hasil karda hain, jis fazl-o-rahmat ka bayan is aayat mein hai woh yeh nahi.

Bighair sharai daleel ke halal-o-haram ki muzammat. Mushrikin ne baaz janwar مخصوص (makhsoos) naam rakh kar apne liye haram qarar de rakhe the, is amal ki tardeed mein yeh aayatein hain. Jaise aur aayat mein hai ke Allah ki paida ki hui khetiyon aur chaupayon mein yeh kuch na kuch hissa to is ka karte hain. Musnad Ahmad mein hai, Hazrat Auf bin Malik bin Fazlah R.A farmate hain main Rasool Allah ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir hua. Us waqt meri halat yeh thi ke mela kachela jism, baal bikhre hue. Aap ﷺ ne mujh se pucha, tumhare paas kuch maal bhi hai? Main ne kaha ji haan. Aap ne farmaya ke kis qism ka maal? Main ne kaha oont, ghulam, ghore, bakriyan waghera gharz har qism ka maal hai. Aap ne farmaya jab Allah Ta'ala ne tujhe sab kuch de rakha hai to is ka asar bhi tere jism par zahir hona chahiye. Phir aap ne pucha ke tere haan oontniyan bachche bhi deti hain? Main ne kaha haan. Farmaya woh bilkul theek thak hote hain phir tu apne haath mein chhuri le kar kisi ka kaan kaat ke is ka naam bahira rakh leta hai? Kisi ki khaal kaat kar haram naam rakh leta hai? Phir ise apne upar aur apne walon par haram samajh leta hai? Main ne kaha haan yeh bhi theek hai. Aap ﷺ ne farmaya sun Allah ne tujhe jo diya hai woh halal hai. Allah Ta'ala ka baazu tere baazu se qawi hai aur Allah Ta'ala ki chhuri teri chhuri se bahut zyada tez hai. Allah Ta'ala ne is aayat mein logon ke fe'l ki poori muzammat bayan farmai hai jo apni taraf se bighair sharai daleel ke kisi haram ko halal ya kisi halal ko haram thahra lete hain. Unhein Allah ne qayamat ke azaab se dhamkaya hai aur farmaya hai ke un ka kya khayal hai? Yeh kis hawa mein hain? Kya yeh nahi jaante ke yeh bebas ho kar qayamat ke din hamare samne hazir kiye jayenge. Allah Ta'ala to logon par apna fazl-o-karam hi karta hai. Woh duniya mein saza dene mein jaldi nahi karta. Usi ka fazl hai ke is ne duniya mein bahut si nafa ki cheezein logon ke liye halal kar di hain. Sirf unhi cheezon ko haram farmaya hai jo bandon ko nuqsaan pahunchane wali aur un ke haq mein muzir hain, duniyawi taur par ya ukhrawi taur par. Lekin aksar log nashukri kar ke Allah ki naimaton se mahroom ho jaate hain, apni janon ko khud tangi mein dalte hain. Mushrik log isi tarah az-khud ahkam ghar liya karte the aur unhein shariat samajh baithte the. Ahl-e-Kitab ne bhi apne deen mein aisi hi biddatein ijad kar li thin. Tafsir Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai, qayamat ke din Awliya Allah ki teen qismein kar ke unhein Janab-e-Bari ke samne laya jayega. Pehli qism walon mein se ek se sawal hoga ke tum logon ne yeh nekiyan kyun ki hain? Woh jawab denge ke Parwardigar tu ne jannat banai, is mein darakht lagaye, un darakhton mein phal paida kiye, wahan nahrein jari keen, hoorein paida keen aur naimatein tayar keen, pas isi jannat ke shauq mein hum raton ko bedar rahe aur dinon ko bhook pyaas uthai. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga achcha to tumhare aamal jannat ke hasil karne ke liye the.

Main tumhein Jannat mein jaane ki ijazat deta hoon aur yeh mera khas fazal hai ki Jahannam se tumhein najat deta hoon. Go yeh bhi mera fazal hi hai ki main tumhein Jannat mein pohanchata hoon pas yeh aur iske sab sathi Behisht-e-Bareen mein dakhil ho jayenge. Phir doosri qisam ke logon mein se ek se poocha jayega ki tum ne yeh nekiyan kaise keen? Woh kahega Parvardigar tu ne Jahannam ko paida kiya. Apne dushmano aur nafarmano ke liye wahan tauq-o-zanjeer, hararat, aag, garam pani aur garam hawa ka azab rakha wahan tarah tarah ke rooh-farsa dukh dene wale azab tayyar kiye. Pas main raton ko jagta raha, dinon ko bhooka pyasa raha, sirf is Jahannam se dar kar, to Allah Ta'ala farmayega. Main ne tujhe is Jahannam se azad kiya aur tujh par mera yeh khas fazal hai ki tujhe apni Jannat mein le jata hoon pas yeh aur iske sathi sab Jannat mein chale jayenge phir teesri qisam ke logon mein se ek ko laya jayega Allah Ta'ala us se daryaft farmayega ki tum ne nekiyan kyun keen? Woh jawab dega ki sirf teri mohabbat mein aur tere shauq mein. Teri izzat ki qasam main raton ko ibadat mein jagta raha aur dinon ko roze rakh kar bhook pyas sehta raha, yeh sab sirf tere shauq aur teri mohabbat ke liye tha. Allah Ta'ala farmayega tu ne yeh aamal sirf meri mohabbat aur mere ishtiyaq mein hi kiye. Le ab mera deedar karle. Us waqt Allah Ta'ala Jal Jalaluhu اسے aur iske sathiyon ko apna deedar karayega, farmayega dekh le, yeh hoon main, phir farmayega yeh mera khas fazal hai ki main tujhe Jahannam se bachata hoon aur Jannat mein pohanchata hoon mere farishte tere paas pohnchte rahenge aur main khud bhi tujh par salam kaha karunga, pas woh ma'a apne sathiyon ke Jannat mein chala jayega.

Sari makhlooq ke kul kaam uske ilm mein hain. Uske ilm se aur uski nigaah se aasman-o-zameen ka koi zarra bhi poshida nahi. Sab chhoti bari cheezein zahir kitab mein likhi hui hain. Al-An'am: 59). Ghaib ki kunjiyan usi ke paas hain. Jinhein us ke siwa koi nahi jaanta. Woh khushki aur tari ki har cheez ka ilm rakhta hai, har patte ke jharne ki use khabar hai. Zameen ke andheron mein jo dana ho, jo tar-o-khushk cheez ho, sab kitab-e-mubein mein mojood hai. Ek aur ayat mein hai ke zameen ke har jandar ka rozi rasan Allah Ta'ala hai. Auliya-e-Allah ka ta'aruf
Auliya-e-Allah woh hain jin ke dilon mein iman-o-yaqin ho, jin ka zahir taqwa aur parhezgari mein duba hua ho, jitna taqwa hoga, utni hi vilayat hogi. Aise log mahz nadar aur be-khauf hain qiyamat ke din ki vahshat un se door hai, na woh kabhi gham-o-ranj se ashna honge. Duniya mein jo chhoot jaye us par unhein hasrat-o-afsos nahi hota. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood, Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas R.A aur bahut se salaf-e-saleheen farmate hain ki Auliya-e-Allah woh hain jin ke chehra dekhne se Allah yaad ajaye. Bazzar ki marfoo hadith mein bhi yeh aya hai. Woh hadith mursalan bhi marvi hai. Ibn Jarir mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain Allah ke ba'az bande aise bhi hain jin par anbiya aur shuhada bhi rashq karenge. Logon ne pucha Huzoor ﷺ woh kaun hain? Humein bataiye taqe hum bhi un se mohabbat-o-ulfat rakhein. Ap ﷺ ne farmaya "Yeh log hain jo sirf Allah ki wajah se aapas mein mohabbat rakhte hain. Mali fayde ki wajah se nahi, unhein rishtedaari aur nasab ki bina par nahi. Sirf Allah ke deen ki wajah se. Un ke chehre noorani honge, yeh noor ke mimbaron par honge. Sab ko dar-o-khauf hoga lekin yeh bilkul be-khauf aur mahz nadar honge, jab log ghamzada honge yeh be-gham honge". Phir ap ne yehi ayat tilawat farmayi. Yehi riwayat munqati' sanad se Abu Dawood mein bhi hai. Wallahu A'lam. 
Masnad Ahmad ki ek matavval hadith mein hai ki door daraaz ke rehne wale khandanon aur baradariyon se alag shuda log jin mein koi rishta, kunba, kaum, baradari nahi, woh mahz tauhid-o-sunnat ki wajah se Allah ki razamandi ke hasil karne ke liye aapas mein ek ho gaye honge aur aapas mein mel-milap, mohabbat, mawaddat, dosti aur bhai-chara rakhte honge. Deen mein sab ek honge. Un ke liye qiyamat ke din Allah Ta'ala noorani mimbar bicha dega jin par woh izzat se tashreef rakhenge. Log pareshan honge lekin yeh batmainan honge. Yeh hain woh Allah ke Auliya jin par koi khauf-o-gham nahi.

Khwabon ke bare mein
Masnad Ahmad mein hai ki Rasool Allah ﷺ ne basharaton ki tafsir bayan karte huve farmaya ki yeh naik khwab hain jinhein musalman dekhe ya us ke liye dikhaye jayen. Hazrat Abu Darda R.A se jab is ka sawal hua toh ap ne farmaya tum ne aj mujh se woh baat puchi jo tum se pehle kisi ne nahi puchi siwai us shakhs ke jis ne yehi sawal Huzoor ﷺ se kiya tha aur ap ﷺ ne is jawab ke dene se pehle nahi farmaya tha ki tujh se pehle mere kisi ummati ne mujh se yeh sawal nahi kiya. Khud inhi sahabi se jab sail ne is ayat ki tafsir puchi toh ap ne bhi yeh keh kar phir tafsir marfoo hadith se bayan farmayi. Aur riwayat mein hai Hazrat Ubada R.A ne sawal kiya ki akhirat ki basharat toh jannat hai, duniya ki basharat kya hai? Farmaya naik khwab jise banda dekhe ya us ke liye auron ko dikhaye jayen. Yeh nubuwwat ka chaliswan ya satrawan juz hai. Hazrat Abu Zar R.A ne ap se pucha ki Ya Rasool Allah! insan nekiyan karta hai phir logon mein us ki tareef hoti hai? Ap ﷺ ne farmaya yehi duniyavi basharat hai.

(Muslim) farmate hain ke duniya ki basharat naik khwab hain jin se momin ko khushkhabri sunai jati hai. Yeh nubuwwat ka unchaswan hissa hai is ke dekhne wale ko isse bayan karna chahiye aur jo iske siwa dekhe woh shaitani khwab hain taake isse gham-zada kar de. Chahiye ke aise mauqa par teen dafa bayen janib thhatkar de. Allah ki barai bayan kare aur kisi se is khwab ko bayan na kare. (Musnad Ahmad) Aur riwayat mein hai ke naik khwab nubuwwat ka chhiyaliswan hissa hai. Aur hadith mein hai duniyawi basharat naik khwab. Aur ukhrawi basharat jannat. Ibn Jarir mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain nubuwwat jati rahi khushkhabariyan reh gayin. Bushra ki yehi tafsir Ibn Masood, Abu Hurairah, Ibn Abbas, Mujahid, Urwah, Ibn Zubair, Yahya bin Abi Kathir, Ibrahim Nakhai, Ata bin Abi Rabah, waghera salaf saleheen se marwi hai. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke murad is se woh khushkhabri hai jo momin ko iski maut ke waqt farishte dete hain jiska zikr (Aayat Innal-lazina qalu RabbunAllah-ul-Kh) mein hai ke sache pakke momino ke paas farishte aate hain aur kehte hain ke tum khauf na karo, tum gham na karo, tumhe hum us jannat ki khushkhabri sunate hain jiska tumse wada kiya jata raha hai. Hum duniya o akhirat mein tumhare kar-saz wali hain. Suno tum jo chahoge jannat mein paoge, jo mango ge milega. Tum Ghafoor o Raheem Allah ke khas mehmaan banoge. Hazrat Bara ؓ ki mutawwil hadith mein hai momin ki maut ke waqt noorani safed chehre wale pak saaf ajle safed kapro wale farishte uske paas aate hain aur kehte hain he pak rooh chal kushadgi rahat taro-tazgi aur khushboo aur bhalai ki taraf chal. Tere us Palanhaar ki taraf jo tujh se kabhi khafa nahi hone ka. Pas iski rooh is basharat ko sun kar iske munh se itni asani aur shauq se nikalti hai jaise mashk ke munh se pani ka koi qatra chhoot jaye. Aur akhirat ki basharat ka zikr (Lā yahzunuhumul-fazaul-akbaru wa tatalaqqāhumul-malā'ikatu hāzā yawmukumul-lazī kuntum tū'adūn) (21. Al-Anbiya: 103) mein hai yani unhe us din ki zabardast pareshani bilkul hi na ghabrayegi idhar udhar se unke paas farishte aaye honge aur kehte honge ke is din ka tumse wada kiya jata raha tha. Ek aayat mein hai (Yawma taral-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti yas'ā nūruhum bayna aydīhim wa bi-aymānihim bushra-kumul-yawma jannātun tajrī min tahtihal-anhāru khālidīna fīhā zālika huwal-fawzul-'azīm) (57. Al-Hadid: 12) jis din tu momin mardo aurto ko dekhega ke unka noor unke aage aage aur dayen taraf chal raha hoga. Lo tum khushkhabri sun lo ke aaj tumhe woh jannatein milengi. Jinke niche nahrein lehrein le rahi hain. Jahan ki rehaish hamesha ki hogi. Yehi zabardast kamyabi hai. Allah ka wada ghalat nahi hota. Woh wada khilafi nahi karta, usne jo farma diya sach hai, sabit hai, atal hai yaqeeni aur zaroori hai.

Silsila-e-Risalat ka tazkira: Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ke baad bhi Rasoolon ka silsila jari raha, har Rasool apni qoum ki taraf Allah ka paigham aur apni sachai ki dalelein lekar aata raha. Lekin umuman un sab ke sath bhi logon ki wahi purani rosh rahi. Yaani unki sachai tasleem ko na kiya, jaise (Wa nuqallibu af'idatahum wa absarahum kama lam yu'minu bihi awwala marratin wa nazaruhum fi tughyanihim ya'mahun) (Surah Al-An'am: 110) mein hai.

Pas un ke had se barh jaane ki wajah se jis tarah un ke dilon par mohar lag gayi, usi tarah un jaise tamam logon ke dilon par mohar zada ho jaate hain aur azaab dekh lene se pehle unhein iman naseeb nahi hota. Yaani nabiyon aur un ke tabiadaron ko bacha lena aur mukhalifin ko halak karna. Hazrat Nuh Nabi (A.S) ke baad se barabar yehi hota raha hai. 

Hazrat Adam (A.S) ke zamane mein bhi insan zameen par abad the. Jab un mein but-parasti shuru ho gayi to Allah Ta'ala ne apne paighambar Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ko un mein bheja. Yehi wajah hai ki jab Qayamat ke din log Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ke paas sifarish ki darkhwast lekar jayenge to kahenge ki aap pehle Rasool hain, jinhein Allah Ta'ala ne zameen walon ki taraf mabouth farmaya. 

Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain ki Hazrat Adam (A.S) aur Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ke darmiyan das zamane guzre aur woh sab Islam mein hi guzre hain. Isi liye farman-e-Khuda hai ki Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ke baad ke aane walon ko hum ne un ki bad-kardariyon ke baais halak kar diya. 

Maqsood yeh hai ki in baaton ko sun kar mushrikeen-e-Arab hoshiyar ho jaaein kyunki woh sabse afzal-o-a'la Nabi ko jhutla rahe hain. Pas jabki un ke kam martabe nabiyon aur rasoolon ke jhutlane par aise dehshat-afza azaab sabqa logon par nazil ho chuke hain, to is Sayyid-ul-Mursaleen (ﷺ), Imam-ul-Anbiya (ﷺ) ke jhutlane par un se bhi badtareen azaab un par nazil honge.

In nabiyon ke baad hum ne Musa aur Harun ko Firon aur us ki kaum ke paas bheja. Apni daleelein aur hujjatein ata farma kar bheja. Lekin Aal-e-Firon ne bhi itteba-e-haq se takabbur kiya aur thay bhi pakke mujrim aur qasmein kha kar kaha ki yeh toh sarih jadoo hai. Halanki dil qayil thay ki yeh haq hai lekin sirf apni barhi charhi khud-rayi aur zulm ki aadat se majboor thay. Is par Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ne samjhaya ki Allah ke sachay deen ko jadoo keh kar kyun apni halakat ko bula rahe ho? Kahin jadugar bhi kamyaab hotay hain? Un par is naseehat ne bhi ulta asar kiya aur do aitraz aur jar diye ki tum toh hamein apne baap dada ki rosh se hata rahe ho. Aur is se niyat tumhari yehi hai ki is mulk ke maalik ban jao. So bukte raho hum toh tumhari maanne ke nahi. Is qisse ko Quran-e-Kareem mein baar baar dohraya gaya hai, is liye ki yeh ajeeb-o-ghareeb qissa hai. Firon Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) se bohat darta bachta raha. Lekin qudrat ne Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ko usi ke haan palwaya aur shahzaadon ki tarah izzat ke gahware mein jhoolaya. Jab jawani ki umar ko pohnche toh ek aisa sabab khara kar diya ki yahan se aap chalay gaye. Phir Janab-e-Bari ne un se khud kalaam kiya. Nabuwat-o-risalat di aur usi ke haan phir bheja. Faqat ek Harun (Alaihis Salam / A.S) ko sath de kar aap ne yahan aake is azeem-o-shashan sultan ke rob-o-dabdabe ki koi parwaah na kar ke usay deen-e-haq ki dawat di. Is sarkash ne is par bohat bura manaya aur kameena pan par utar aya. Lekin Allah Ta'ala ne apne dono rasoolon ki khud hi hifazat ki, woh woh mojizat apne nabi ke hathon mein zahir kiye ke un ke dil un ki naboot maan gaye. Lekin taham un ka nafs iman par amada na hua aur yeh apne kufr se zara bhi idhar udhar na huwe. Aakhir Allah ka azaab aa hi gaya aur un ki jarein kaat di gayin. Falhamdulillah.

Bazdali iman ke darmiyan deewar ban gayi. In zabardast roshan daleelon ke aur mojizon ke bawajud Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) par bohat kam Firauni iman la sake. Kyunke unke dil mein Firaun ki dhaak baithi hui thi. Yeh khabees raub-dabdabe wala bhi tha aur taraqi par bhi tha. Haq zahir ho gaya tha lekin kisi ko iski mukhalifat ki jurrat na thi. Har ek ka khauf tha ki agar aaj main iman le aaya to kal iski sakht sazaon se majboor ho kar deen-e-haq chhodna padega. Pas bohat se aise jaanbaaz muwahhid jinhon ne iski saltanat aur saza ki koi parwah na ki aur haq ke samne sar jhuka diya. In mein khususi taur par qabil-e-zikr Firaun ki biwi thi, uski al ka ek aur shakhs tha, ek jo Firaun ka khazanchi tha, uski biwa thi, waghairah Razi Allahu Anhum Ajma'in.

Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ki murad isse Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) par Bani Israel ki thodi si tadad ka iman lana hai. Yeh bhi marwi hai ki zurriyat se murad qaleel hai yaani bohat kam log. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ki aulad bhi murad hai. Yaani jab Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) nabi ban kar aaye us waqt jo log hain unki maut ke baad unki aulad mein se kuch log iman laye.

Imam Ibn Jarir to qaul-e-Mujahid ko pasand farmate hain ki qoumihi mein zameer ka marji' Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) hain kyunke yahi naam isse qareeb hai. Lekin yeh mahal-e-nazar hai kyunke zurriyat ke lafz ka taqaza jawan aur kam umr log hain aur Bani Israel to sab ke sab momin the jaisa ki mashhoor hai. Yeh to Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ke aane ki khushiyan mana rahe the, unki kitabon mein maujood tha ki is tarah Nabiullah aayenge aur unke hathon unhe Firaun ki ghulami ki zillat se nijat milegi. Unki kitabon ki yahi baat to Firaun ke hosh-o-hawas gum kiye hui thi jiski wajah se usne Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ki dushmani par kamar kas li thi aur aap ki nubuwwat ke zahir hone se pehle aur aap ke aane se pehle aur aap ke aa jaane ke baad hum to uske hathon bohat hi tang kiye gaye hain. Aap ne unhe tasalli di ki jaldi na karo. Allah tumhare dushman ka naas karega, tumhein mulk ka malik banayega phir dekhega ki tum kya karte ho?

Pas yeh to samajh mein nahi aata ki is aayat se murad qoum-e-Musa ki nayi nasl ho. Aur yeh ki Bani Israel mein se siwaye Qaroon ke aur koi deen ka chhodne wala aisa na tha jiske fitne mein pad jaane ka khauf ho. Qaroon go qoum-e-Musa mein se tha lekin woh baghi tha, Firaun ka dost tha. Uske hashiya-nasheenon mein tha, usse gehre talluq jo rakhta tha.

Jo log kehte hain ki malaihim mein zameer Firaun ki taraf aaid hai aur bator iske tabadari karne walon ki ziyadti ke zameer jama ki layi gayi hai. Ya yeh ki Firaun se pehle lafz al jo mudhaf tha mahzoof kar diya gaya hai aur mudhaf ilaih uske qaim-maqam rakh diya hai. Unka qaul bhi bohat door ka hai. Go Imam Ibn Jarir ne ba'z nahwiyon se bhi in dono aqwal ki hikayat ki hai aur isse agli aayat jo aa rahi hai woh bhi dalalat karti hai ki Bani Israel sab momin the.

Allah par mukammal bharosa iman ki ruh. Hazrat Musa (A.S) apni kaum Bani Israel se farmate hain ki agar tum momin musalman ho to Allah par bharosa rakho, jo us par bharosa kare woh use kafi hai. Ibadat-o-tawwakkul dono ham-pala cheezein hain. Farman-e-Rab hai:

(Fa'budhu wa tawakkal 'alayhi, wa ma Rabbuka bi-ghafilin 'amma ta'malun) (11. Hud: 123)

Usisi ki ibadat kar aur usisi par bharosa rakh. Ek aur ayat mein apne Nabi (ﷺ) ko irshad farmata hai ki keh de ki Rab-e-Rahman par hum iman laye aur usisi ki zat-e-pak par hum ne tawakkul kiya. Farmata hai: Mashriq-o-Maghrib ka Rab jo ibadat ke laike ma'bud hai, jis ke siwa parastish ke laik aur koi nahi. Tu usisi ko apna wakil-o-karsaz bana le. Tamam imandaron ko jo surat panchhon namazon mein tilawat karne ka hukum hua us mein bhi un ki zubani iqrar karaya gaya hai ki hum teri hi ibadat karte hain aur tujh se hi madad talab karte hain.

Banu Israel ne apne Nabi (A.S) ka yeh hukum sun kar itaat ki aur jawab'an arz kiya ki, "Hamara bharosa apne Rab par hi hai. Parwardigar! Tu hamein zalimon ke liye fitna na bana ki woh hum par ghalib reh kar yeh samajhne lagein ki agar yeh haq par hote aur hum batil par hote toh hum un par ghalib kaise reh sakte."

Yeh matlab bhi is dua ka bayan kiya gaya hai ki, "Allah! Hum par un ke hathon azab musallat na karana, na apne pas se koi azab hum par nazil farma ki yeh log kehne lagein ki agar Bani Israel haq par hote toh hamari sazayein kyun bhugatte ya Allah ke azab un par kyun utarte?"

Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ki agar yeh hum par ghalib rahe toh aisa na ho ki yeh kahein hamare sachhe din se hamein hatane ke liye koshishein karein. Aur he Parwardigar! In kafiron se jinhone haq se inkar kar diya hai, haq ko chhupa liya hai, toh hamein nijat de, hum tujh par iman laye hain aur hamara bharosa sirf teri zat par hai.

Qaum-e-Firaun se Bani Israel ki Nijaat

Bani Israel ki Firaun aur Firaun ki qaum se nijaat pana, is ki kafiyat bayan ho rahi hai, dono nabiyon ko Allah ki wahi hui ke "Apni qaum ke liye Misr mein ghar bana lo aur apne gharon ko masjidain muqarrar kar lo aur khauf ke waqt gharon mein namaz ada kar liya karo."

Chunache Firaun ki sakhti bahut barh gayi thi, isliye unhein kasrat se namaz ada karne ka hukum hua. Yehi hukum is ummat ko bhi hai ke aye iman walo! Sabr aur namaz se madad chaho. Huzoor ﷺ ki aadat-e-mubarak bhi yehi thi ke jab koi ghabrahat hoti, foran namaz ke liye khare ho jaate.

Yahan bhi hukum hota hai ke apne gharon ko qibla bana lo, aye Nabi ﷺ! In mominoon ko tum basharat do, unhein dar-e-akhirat mein sawab milega aur duniya mein un ki ta'eed-o-nusrat hogi.

Israiliyon ne apne nabi se kaha tha ke Firauniyon ke samne hum apni namaz elan se nahi parh sakte, to Allah ne unhein hukum diya ke apne ghar qibla-ru ho kar wahin namaz ada kar sakte ho. Apne ghar samne samne banane ka hukum ho gaya.

Firoon ka takabbur aur Musa Alaihis Salam ki bad-dua:

Wajood in khule waqiat ke bhi aksar log hamari ayton se ghaflat baratte hain. Kuch naseehat hasil nahi karte. In Firauniyon ka gharq hona aur Hazrat Musa (A.S) ka ma'e musalmanon ke najat pana Ashoore ke din hua tha. Chunacha Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine mein aaye toh yahudiyon ko is din ka roza rakhte hue dekha. Woh kehte the ke isi din Hazrat Musa (A.S) Firaun par ghalib aaye the. Firaun jab maujon mein phans gaya aur sakarat-e-maut ka use maza aane laga toh kehne laga ke main lasharik Rab-e-Wahid par iman lata hoon. Jis par Bani Israel iman laaye hain. Zahir hai ke azab ke dekh chukne ke baad azab ke aa jane ke baad iman soodmand nahi hota. Allah Ta'ala is baat ko farma chuka hai aur yeh qaada jari kar chuka hai. Isi liye Firaun ko jawab mila ke is waqt yeh kehta hai halanke ab tak shar-o-fasad par tala raha. Poori umar Allah ki nafarmaniyan karta raha. Mulk mein fasad machata raha. Khud gumrah ho kar auron ko bhi rah-e-haq se rokta raha. Logon ko jahannam ki taraf bulane ka imam tha. Qayamat ke din be-yar-o-madadgar rahega. Firaun ka us waqt ka qoul Allah Ta'ala Allam-ul-Ghooyib ne apne ilm-e-ghaib se Anhadrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se bayan farmaya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke is waqiye ki khabar dete waqt Jibrail (A.S) ne mujh se farmaya ke kaash aap us waqt hote aur dekhte ke main iske munh mein keechad thons raha tha is khayal se ke kahin iski baat poori hone par Allah ki rehmat iski dastgiri na kar le. Ibn Abbas farmate hain doobte waqt Firaun ne shahadat ki ungli aasman ki taraf utha kar apne iman ka iqrar karna shuru kiya jis par Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) ne iske munh mein mitti bharni shuru ki. Is Firaun Kathir bin Zazan maloon ka munh Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) us waqt band kar rahe the aur iske munh keechad thons rahe the Wallahu A'lam. Kehte hain ke ba'z Bani Israel ko Firaun ki maut mein shak paida ho gaya tha. Is liye Allah Ta'ala ne darya ko hukum diya ke iski laash buland teele par khushki mein daal de taake yeh apni ankhon se dekh lein aur iska muainah kar lein. Chunacha iska jism ma'e iske libas ke khushki par daal diya gaya taake Bani Israel ko maloom ho jaye aur unke liye nishani aur ibrat ban jaye aur woh jaan lein ke gazab-e-Ilahi ko koi cheez dafa nahi kar sakti. Wajood in khule waqiat ke bhi aksar log hamari ayton se ghaflat baratte hain. Kuch naseehat hasil nahi karte. In Firauniyon ka gharq hona aur Hazrat Musa (A.S) ka ma'e musalmanon ke najat pana Ashoore ke din hua tha. Chunacha Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Madine mein aaye toh yahudiyon ko is din ka roza rakhte hue dekha. Woh kehte the ke isi din Hazrat Musa (A.S) Firaun par ghalib aaye the. Aap ne apne ashab se farmaya ke tum toh Hazrat Musa (A.S) ke ba-nisbat unke zyada haqdar ho tum bhi is Ashoore ke din ka roza rakho.

Bani Israel par Allah ke inaamat: Allah ne jo naimatein Bani Israel par inaam farmayien un ka zikr ho raha hai ke Sham aur mulk-e-Misr mein Bait-ul-Muqaddas ke aas paas unhein jagah di. Tamam-o-kamal mulk-e-Misr par un ki hukumat ho gayi. Firon ki halakat ke baad daulat-e-Mousawiya qaim ho gayi. Jaise Quran mein bayan hai ke hum ne in kamzor Bani Israiliyoun ke mashriq maghrib ke mulk ka malik kar diya. Barkat wali zameen un ke qabze mein de di aur un par apni sachi baat ki sachayi khol di un ke sabr ka phal unhein mil gaya. Firon, farouni aur un ki kariwariyaan sab nest-o-nabood huien aur aayoun mein hai ke hum ne farouniyoun ko baghoun se, dushmanoun se, khazanoun se behtareen muqamat aur makanat se nikaal bahir kiya. Aur Bani Israel ke qabze mein yeh sab kuch kar diya. Aur aayoun mein hai (Kam taraku min jannatin wa 'uyun - 44. Ad-Dukhan: 25).

Wajood is ke Khalil-ur-Rahman (Alaihis Salam) ke shehar Bait-ul-Muqaddas ki muhabbat un ke dil mein chutkiyan leti rahi. Wahan Amalqa ki kaum ka qibla tha unhon ne apne paigambar (Alaihis Salam) se darkhwast ki, unhein jihad ka hukam hua yeh namardi kar gaye jis ke badle unhein chaalis saal tak maidan-e-Tih mein sargardan phirna pada. Wahin Hazrat Haroon (Alaihis Salam) ka inteqal hua phir Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ka. Un ke baad yeh Hazrat Yusha bin Noon (Alaihis Salam) ke sath nikle. Allah Ta'ala ne un ke hathon par Bait-ul-Muqaddas ko fath kiya. Yahan Bakht Nassar ke zamane tak unhi ka qabza raha phir kuch muddat ke baad dobara unhon ne ise le liya phir Yunani badshahoun ne wahan qabza kiya. Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ke zamane tak wahan Yunaniyon ka hi qabza raha. Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ki zidd mein in maloon yahoudiyon ne Shah-e-Yunan se saaz baaz ki aur Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ki giraftari ke ahkam unhein baghi qarar de ke nikalwa diye. Allah Tabarak wa Ta'ala ne apne Nabi (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko to apni taraf chadha liya aur aap ke kisi hawari par aap ki shabahat daal di unhon ne aap ke dhoke mein use qatal kar diya aur suli par latka diya. Yaqinan janab Roohullah (Alaihis Salam) un ke hathon qatal nahi huwe. Unhein to Allah Ta'ala ne apni taraf buland kar liya. Allah Aziz-o-Hakeem hai.

Hazrat Isa (Alaihis Salam) ke taqreeban teen sau saal baad Qustuntunia nami Yunani badshah esayi ban gaya. Woh bada paji aur makkar tha. Deen-e-Esawi mein yeh badshah sirf siyasi mansouboun ke poora karne aur apni saltanat ko mazboot karne aur deen-e-Nasara ko badal daalne ke liye ghusa tha. Hila aur makr-o-fareeb aur chaal ke taur par yeh masihi bana tha ke masihiyat ki jadien khokhli kar de. Nasrani ulma aur darweshoun ko jama karke un se qawanin-e-shariat ke majmoue ke naam se nayi nayi tarashi hui baatein likhwa kar un bid'atoun ko nasraniyon mein phaila diya aur asl Kitab-o-Sunnah se unhein hata diya.

Usne kelisa, garjay, khanqahien, haiklein vaghera banayein aur besiyon qism ke mujahiday aur nafs kashi ke tareeqe aur tarah tarah ki ibadatein riyazatein nikal kar logon mein is naye deen ki khoob ishaat ki aur hukumat ke zor aur zar ke lalach se ise door tak pohncha diya. Jo bechare muwahid, muttabi'-e-injeel aur sachche tabe'dar Hazrat Isa Alaihis Salam ke asli deen par qaim rahe unhein in zalimon ne shehar badar kardiya. Yeh log jangalon mein rehne sehne lage aur yeh naye deen wale jin ke hathon mein tabdeeli aur mask wala deen reh gaya tha uth khare hue aur tamam jazeera-e-room par chha gaye. Qustuntuniya ki buniyadein us ne rakhein. Bait-ul-Lahm aur Bait-ul-Muqaddas ke kelisa aur hawariyon ke shehar sab usi ke basaye hue hain. Bari bari shandar, derpa aur mazboot imaratein us ne banayein. Saleeb ki parastish, mashriq ka qibla, kanison ki tasveerein, soor ka khana vaghera yeh sab cheezein nasraniyat mein usi ne dakhil keen. Furoo'-o-usool sab badal kar deen-e-masih ko ulat pulat kardiya. Amanat-e-kabeera usi ki ijad hai aur darasal zaleel tareen khiyanat hai. Lambe choure fiqhi masail ki kitabein usi ne likhwayin. Ab Bait-ul-Muqaddas unhi ke hathon mein tha yahan tak ke Sahaba-e-Rasool ﷺ ne ise fateh kiya. Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ki khilafat mein yeh muqaddas shehar is muqaddas jama'at ke qabze mein aaya. Al-gharz yeh pak jagah unhein mili thi aur pak rozi Allah ne de rakhhi thi jo shara'an bhi halal aur tab'an bhi tayyib. Afsos bawajood Allah ki kitab hath mein hone ke unhon ne khilaf bazi aur firqa-bandi shuru kardi. Aik do nahi behtar (73) firqe qaim ho gaye. Allah apne Rasool par durood salam nazil farmaye Aap ne in ki is phoot ka zikr farma kar farmaya ke meri ummat mein bhi yehi bimari phailayegi aur in ke sattar (70) se zayada firqe ho jayenge jis mein se aik jannati baqi sab dozakhi honge, pooncha gaya ke jannati kaun hain? Farmaya woh jo us par hon jis par main aur mere Sahaba hain. (Mustadrak Hakim) Allah farmata hai in ke ikhtilaf ka faisla qayamat ke din mein aap hi karunga

Thos dalaeil ke bawajood inkar qabil-e-mazammat hai. Jab yeh ayat utri toh Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya na mujhe kuch shak na mujhe kisi se poochne ki zaroorat. Pas is ayat se matlab sirf itna hai ke aap ki ummat ke iman ki mazbooti ki jaye aur un se bayan kiya jaye ke agli ilahami kitabon mein bhi un ke nabi ki sifatain maujood hain, khud Ahl-e-Kitab bhi bakhubi waqif hain. Jaise (Allazina yattabi'unar-rasulan-nabiyyal-ummiyyal-allazi yajiduunahu maktuban 'indahum fit-taurati wal-injeel) 7. Al-A'raf: 157 mein hai. In logon par taajjub aur afsos hai un ki kitabon mein is Nabi-e-Akhir-uz-Zaman ki tareef-o-tauseef aur jaan-pehchan hone ke bawajood bhi un kitabon ke ahkam ko khalt-malt karte hain aur tahreef-o-tabdeel kar ke baat badal dete hain aur daleel samne hone ke bawajood inkaari rehte hain. Shak-o-shubah ki mumanat ke baad ayat-e-Rabb ki takzeeb ki mumanat hui. Phir badqismat logon ke iman se na-ummidi dilai gayi. Jab tak ke woh azab na dekh lein iman nahi layenge. Yeh toh us waqt iman layenge jis waqt iman lana be-sood hoga. Hazrat Musa (Alaihis Salam) ne Firaun ke liye aur Firauniyon ke liye yahi baddua ki thi. Un ki jahalat is darjay par pohanch chuki hai ke bilfarz hum apne farishton ko un par utarein, murday un se bole, har poshida cheez samne ajaye jab bhi unhein iman naseeb nahi hoga haan marzi-e-Maula aur cheez hai.
